content.bridge_context: We learn to quantify the world by measuring 'how heavy' (Weight) and 'how much it holds' (Capacity).

units.title: Standard Units of Weight
units.explanation: We use grams (g) for light objects and kilograms (kg) for heavy objects. 1 kg = 1000 g.
units.dual_language_instruction: Convert kg to g. / किलोग्राम को ग्राम में बदलें।

units.title: Standard Units of Capacity
units.explanation: We use milliliters (ml) for small amounts of liquid and liters (l) for large amounts. 1 l = 1000 ml.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the unit (l or ml). / इकाई (लीटर या मिलीलीटर) की पहचान करें।
